labels.sickDaysHint: Total sick leave days taken in one year.
labels.normalTotal: Normal pay for the same days

notes.outside: {days} of these days fall beyond the 55-day sick leave schedule, so they are not covered by the statutory sick pay shown here.
notes.rules: Under Bahrain's Labour Law, sick leave in a year is paid at full wage for the first 15 days, half wage for the next 20 days, and is unpaid for the following 20 days.
notes.disclaimer: Estimate only. The daily rate is monthly wage divided by 30, and your contract may be more generous. Confirm with your employer or the Labour Market Regulatory Authority.
